change_summary: Added an end-to-end unsplittable log-target criterion test and extended existing learning contracts to absolute_error. Added reordered/repeated row prediction alignment assertions. Production code and model configuration were already present and were not edited in this stage.
coverage: For seeds 42 and 43, identical features and thresholds with targets [1, 1, 10000] seconds yield approximately 1 second with absolute_error and 10**(4/3) seconds with both omitted and explicit squared_error. Assertions use rtol=1e-12 and atol=0; fitted forest and tree criteria and single-node tree structure are checked.

Fold-locality fixtures exercise squared_error and absolute_error at both fixed seeds with 400 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=1.0 and n_jobs=4. Vocabulary, median imputation statistics, threshold medians, and full fitted-object hashes are checked before and after unseen/nonfinite prediction inputs.
Serialization and the root RuntimeModel adapter cover absolute_error, including numeric featurization, singleton/batch agreement, and bounded predictions on unseen and nonfinite inputs.
Both criteria pass clipping checks below 1e-9 and above the six-hour 21600-second cap, including a mixed endpoint fixture in log space.
Absolute_error passes finite bounded output, empty-input, mismatched-length rejection, reordered/repeated row alignment, identity-feature rejection, and invalid-target rejection checks.
The unchanged parser tests and hist_gradient_boosting smoke test pass as part of the full project suite.
